## What does this change?

## Checklist

- [ ] Content edits are in the `STAGES` array in `index.html`
- [ ] New skills have all six fields (`n`, `h`, `d`, `why`, `chk`, `pit`, `res`) and a unique `n`
- [ ] `d` / `why` / `chk` / `pit` are each one tight sentence
- [ ] Every link I added actually loads, and is specific (not a homepage/channel)
- [ ] I opened the page and it renders in **both** the skill tree and mind map views
- [ ] I checked it in **dark mode**
- [ ] If I renumbered/reordered skills, I bumped the `localStorage` version key
- [ ] No new dependencies, fonts, CDNs, or trackers (the page stays self-contained)
